concept: TV Broadcast Van with Satellite Dish
description: A boxy van facing right, with a slanted windshield window at the front and two round wheels below. The letters TV sit on its side panel, and a satellite dish on a short mast tilts up from the roof.

concept: Hand Holding a Remote with Signal
description: An upright rounded-rectangle remote is gripped from the lower right by a hand whose bent finger curls across its lower face. Two stacked curved signal arcs rise above the remote's top edge.
A wide rounded-rectangle flat-screen television with an empty screen sits on a short splayed central foot. Beneath it, a long low media cabinet with a horizontal shelf line stands on two short legs.

A satellite lies on a diagonal from upper left to lower right: a round central body with a small dot, joined by short struts to two rectangular solar panels. Two concentric quarter-arc signal waves curve around its lower left.
A vertical antenna mast topped by a small ring stands at the centre. Two pairs of concentric curved arcs open outward on the left and right, mirrored symmetrically around the mast.
